unresolved: s. 7 applies Part 3 where a Part 1 bag limit carries ***; whether this Part 3 aggregate governs Part 1 items WITHOUT *** is not settled.

Part 1 item 48 SNOWSHOE HARE prints its bag limit as '10***' (s. 7: triple asterisk means Part 3 restrictions apply), but Part 3 of Schedule 7 contains no hare provision (sections: Deer bag limit, repealed 2, repealed 3, Grouse, repealed 5). Dangling reference; the provincial s. 11 (1) (j) '10 snowshoe hare per day' is the only hare limit found.
